definitions: A nocturnal, burrowing mammal native to the Americas, typically having a leathery armour shell and a long snout.
Any of several mostly nocturnal, burrowing mammals of the family Dasypodidae, native to warm regions of the Americas, having a body covered with an armour of bony plates.
examples: An armadillo rolled into a ball.
We spotted an armadillo by the river.
